LanguageData.LP_ChainDevilWeapon.label: living chains
LanguageData.LP_ChainDevilWeapon.description: A chain on a chain devil's body that lashes out on its own.
LanguageData.LP_BoneDevilTailWeapon.label: scorpion tail stinger
LanguageData.LP_BoneVenom.label: bone venom
LanguageData.LP_BoneVenom.description: The venom of a bone devil's stinger numbs hands and feet: manipulation -20%.
LanguageData.LP_AmnizuDrain.label: forgetfulness
LanguageData.LP_AmnizuDrain.description: An amnizu's finger touched the forehead: the best skill is temporarily -2 levels.
LanguageData.LP_DryadSevered.label: pain of the felled tree
LanguageData.LP_DryadSevered.description: The dryad's tree died, like having half her life pulled out: pain ×1.5, consciousness -30%. She'll die if she doesn't bind to a new tree within 24 hours.
LanguageData.LP_DryadDistant.label: far from the tree
LanguageData.LP_DryadDistant.description: Too far from her tree (over 40 cells or not on the same map): move speed and work speed ×0.5.
LanguageData.LP_RedcapBloodlust.label: bloodthirst
LanguageData.LP_RedcapBloodlust.description: The redcap gets fiercer with every cut: +3 melee damage per stack.
LanguageData.LP_ChangelingGuise.label: thousand faces
LanguageData.LP_ChangelingHidden.label: changeling
LanguageData.LP_WildHunterSpearWeapon.label: fey lance
LanguageData.LP_WildHuntPrey.label: prey of the wild hunt
LanguageData.LP_WildHuntPrey.description: The wild hunt is chasing this person: riders deal +30% damage to them. Safe once they last until 6 AM.
LanguageData.LP_DevaMaceWeapon.label: radiant mace
LanguageData.LP_PlanetarSwordWeapon.label: celestial greatsword
LanguageData.LP_CelestialGuardian.label: guardian angel
LanguageData.LP_CelestialGuardian.description: A deva sent by the good gods to guard the colony: obedience never drops. When 3 or more people in the colony are tainted to the demon mark, it has a 5% chance each day to leave in disappointment.
LanguageData.LP_FallenDevaGuest.label: fallen guest
LanguageData.LP_FallenDevaGuest.description: A fallen deva: wakes once all the wounds are tended and stays as a guest for 10 days; when leaving, patron deity divine favor +30. When people tainted to the demon mark come near it, it has a 10% chance each day to fall into a hostile erinyes.
LanguageData.LP_DevaStupor.label: fallen coma
LanguageData.LP_DevaStupor.description: Fell from the sky, too badly hurt to wake: consciousness at most 10%. Wakes once all the wounds are tended.
LanguageData.LP_RedeemProgress.label: redeem
LanguageData.LP_RedeemProgress.description: A deva is persuading this erinyes to turn back: after 3 times in total she becomes a deva again.
LanguageData.LP_HuntMarked.label: hunted
LanguageData.LP_HuntMarked.description: An erinyes has marked this person: she deals +15% damage to them.
LanguageData.LP_ImpNature.label: infernal imp familiar
LanguageData.LP_ImpNature.description: An imp bound to its master by a familiar pact: invisible when not fighting; master's psychic sensitivity +10% while on the same map; an "imp's intel" letter every 10 days.
LanguageData.LP_PixieNature.label: sprite's friendship
LanguageData.LP_PixieNature.description: The sprite has formed a friendship with its master: sprinkles fey dust once a day, with a 30% chance of a prank every 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_PixieDust_Swift.label: fey dust: light-footed
LanguageData.LP_PixieDust_Diligent.label: fey dust: diligent
LanguageData.LP_PixieDust_Joy.label: fey dust: happy
LanguageData.LP_PixieDust_Veil.label: fey dust: invisible
LanguageData.LP_PixieDust_Veil.description: Turns invisible after standing still for 3 seconds.
